current_evidence: The council's 'Guidance and practice notes' page links only this 'Local validation list' web page, which states 'Last updated: January 2025'. No newer or draft list was found.

issues.detail: Householder (Checklist 11) is reduced to one 'Floor plans / Elevations' row with a garbled trigger. Missing items: the block plan must show the 45-degree line from the nearest neighbouring habitable window; a shadow analysis is needed if the 45-degree code is breached; Green Belt extensions need volume calculations of the original (1948) and proposed dwelling including previous extensions; Green Belt outbuildings 5m or more from the dwelling need a Very Special Circumstances statement; replacement doors/windows on Listed Buildings or in Conservation Areas need 1:20 sections plus a heritage statement. Arboricultural assessment, heritage statement, FRA, surface water details, PEA and a foul water statement (non-mains) are also required where applicable.
issues.evidence: Checklist 11 Householder Application: 'Block plan must show the 45-degree line...'; 'Shadow analysis if the 45-degree code is breached'; 'Green Belt extensions: volume calculations...'

issues.detail: Listed building consent gets the same 'Floor plans / Elevations' row with the Householder Green Belt trigger copied in, plus a 'Lighting Assessment' row placed there only because the lighting text mentions 'Listed buildings'. The actual LBC requirements (Checklist 13) are missing: heritage statement and schedule of works, a structural survey if demolition or conversion is proposed, cross-sections where applicable, and photographs/photomontages.
issues.evidence: Checklist 13 Listed Building Consent: 'Heritage statement and schedule of works'; 'Structural survey if demolition or conversion is proposed'

issues.detail: Several application types are marked '(none)' even though the source gives them local checklists. Advertisement consent (Checklist 1): cross-section plans if internally illuminated, and a heritage statement where applicable. Lawful development certificate (Checklists 5/6): evidence of more than 10 years' continuous use (affidavits, receipts, dated photos) for existing; a description of the use for proposed. Prior approval (Checklist 20, Class MA commercial to residential): transport statement, noise assessment, contamination assessment, heritage statement and FRA where applicable. Demolition (Checklist 8, Part 13 GPDO): site notice statement and photo, method of demolition and restoration, PEA, and a structural survey where a heritage asset would be lost. Works to trees (Checklist 26): supporting photos of the trees.
issues.evidence: Checklists 1, 5, 6, 8, 20 and 26 on the local validation list page

issues.detail: Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment are marked '(none)', but Checklists 23 and 18 require a covering letter stating the amendments to plans or documents. Checklist 21 (Removal of Agricultural Occupancy Condition, an s73 application) has its own rural-worker justification requirements.
issues.evidence: Checklist 23 Section 73: 'Covering letter stating the amendments to plans or documents'; Checklist 18 Non-Material Amendments

issues.detail: Several 'Local List Requirements' headings are not captured at all. Transport Assessment/Statement is missing (only the Travel Plan is captured). Also missing: Surface Water Drainage Strategy (all major applications, Policy SP32); Minerals Statement (development in a minerals consultation area); Agricultural Land Assessment (greenfield solar farms, or 5ha+ of farmland); Agricultural/Rural Worker Dwelling Justification; Groundwater Assessment (underground pollutant storage such as petrol stations, oil storage, cemeteries); Water Framework Directive Assessment (hydropower, bridges over watercourses, flood defences); Schedule of Works (rural or listed building works); Energy statement (major commercial over 100 sqm, and residential where applicable). Checklist-specific items are also missing: a fire assessment and a glare/light-spill assessment for solar panels (Checklist 24); a planning statement with ICNIRP compliance and site-sharing for telecoms (Checklist 25); and HMO requirements (manager's flat/room, transport statement, HIA for 10+ units, cycle and refuse storage) (Checklist 12).
issues.evidence: 'Details of Requirement' section headings: Minerals Statement, Groundwater Assessment, Water Framework Directive (WFD) Assessment, Surface Water Drainage Strategy, Transport Assessment/Statement, Agricultural Land Assessment

issues.detail: The Affordable Housing Statement appears only under Reserved matters, but its source heading says it applies to Full and Reserved Matters applications. It is missing from Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement/Plan (for Full and Reserved Matters) ... net gain of 10 units or more, or where the site has an area of 0.5 hectares or more'

issues.detail: Most requirements (about 18 rows) carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The source is organised by development-type checklists (Major Residential, Minor Residential 1-9 dwellings, Major Commercial/Industrial, Change of Use, Barn Conversions, Equestrian, Agricultural buildings, HMOs, Annexes, Solar, Telecoms), and none of this is reflected. Outline gets only the Landscaping Scheme, although major-development requirements such as Planning Statement, Travel Plan, FRA and Air Quality also apply to outline majors.

The 'Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) information / metric' row's trigger is actually the Daylight/Sunlight Assessment text, duplicated word-for-word in the Daylight/Sunlight row. The real BNG trigger (priority habitat present, residential sites above set thresholds, other sites above 1ha or 1,000m2), and the PEA + BNG metric + draft BNG plan required on most checklists, are lost.
issues.evidence: Grokbot BNG trigger: 'Statutory biodiversity metric tools and guides - GOV.UK ( Daylight/ Sunlight Assessment A Daylight / Sunlight Assessment will be required...'

issues.detail: The 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' row is filled with the retail sequential-test trigger (out-of-town retail/leisure over 2,500 sqm), so it is mislabelled as a flood requirement. The flood sequential test is not what that text describes.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'Assessment including a sequential test will be required for applications involving a proposed out of town retail, entertainment or leisure development ... in excess of 2,500 square metres'

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut off or have neighbouring text bleeding in. Retail Impact runs into 'Checklist 16 - Major Residential...' items. Structural Survey runs into 'Checklist 9 - Dropped Kerb ... Checklist 10 - Equestri'. Ecology is just a tail fragment ('margins); where protected species are present...'). HIA is only 'of the HIA screening assessment, a full HIA may be required', which omits the screening trigger (restaurants, takeaways, leisure, institutions; full HIA for large residential/employment). Planning Obligations/S106 uses viability text. Foul Sewage omits the actual requirement: a Foul Drainage Assessment Form for non-mains drainage.
issues.evidence: Source 'Health Impact Assessment (HIA) Screening' and 'Foul Water Drainage' headings

issues.detail: Most tab_items are fragments of the 'At a Glance' tables for site location and block plans. Examples: 'North Arrow, Scale, Licence Number Colour Format:', 'Urban 4 hectares, Rural 16 hectares File Type:', 'PDF or Printed copies Must include:', 'A4 or A3 Coverage: 36m x 36m or larger File Type:'. Another is a process sentence ('Where planning conditions have been imposed to deal with flood risk ... we can offer advice'). None of these are requirements.
issues.evidence: Annex D (Location Plan) and Annex E (Block Plan) guidance

issues.detail: The same 'Floor plans / Elevations' requirement and trigger text appears under both Householder and Listed building consent. The Daylight/Sunlight trigger also appears twice (BNG and Daylight rows).
issues.evidence: Identical trigger_excerpt strings in the app_type_rows

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wyre Forest local validation list page (last updated January 2025). The extraction largely ignores the 26 application-type checklists: Householder, LBC, Adverts, LDC, prior approval, demolition, s73, NMA and tree works are all missing or wrong. Several local-list headings (Transport Assessment, Surface Water, Minerals, WFD, Groundwater, Agricultural Land) are omitted, and the BNG and flood sequential rows have the wrong text.
